name: Amyl salicylate
description: Amyl salicylate is a synthetic ester used primarily as a fragrance ingredient, valued for its characteristic sweet, floral, and herbaceous scent profile. Pentyl 2-hydroxybenzoate is a recognized alternative name buyers may encounter in technical documentation and supplier listings. The compound with CAS 2050-08-0 functions as both a fragrance component and a fixative in finished formulations. In personal care and cosmetics, it is incorporated into perfumes, soaps, and lotions to deliver a fresh, clover-like floral note. This ingredient provides moderate tenacity in aromatic applications. Coatings and printing ink formulators use it as a solvent carrier to improve resin compatibility and aid in controlled film formation during the manufacturing process. In adhesives and sealant systems, it supports viscosity adjustment and acts as a plasticizing carrier for specific polymer blends. Its solvent properties also make it relevant in specialty coatings where controlled evaporation is a priority. Substrate wetting is another key benefit when utilizing this chemical in industrial formulation priorities. Amyl salicylate is supplied as a clear to pale yellow liquid in standard bulk and drum packaging for global distribution. It is available in fragrance-grade purity meeting industry quality benchmarks, with technical-grade material also offered for industrial solvent applications. Specifications are typically aligned with recognized fragrance industry standards. The material is provided with IFRA conformance documentation where required by the client.
